basics.description: Findable deploys into this subscription and resource group. Every resource is created new, with managed identities only: no keys, no connection strings. Pick the region below; every resource is created there, whatever region the resource group has. Choose one where the Azure AI Foundry models you want are offered.

basics.name: baseName
basics.label: Deployment name
basics.subLabel: The seed for every resource name
basics.toolTip: 3 to 17 lowercase letters and digits. Every resource is named after it; the web app, the storage account, the Cosmos DB account, the search service and the AI accounts add a 7-character suffix so the name stays unique across Azure (the web app becomes https://<name>-<suffix>.azurewebsites.net; the deployment's webAppUrl output has the exact address).

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3 to 17 lowercase letters and digits with no other characters.

options.text: Names that must be unique across Azure (the web app, the storage account, the Cosmos DB account, the search service and the Foundry account) get a 7-character suffix computed from the resource group and this name, so any name works and a redeploy into the same resource group keeps the same names. The region is checked against Azure as you pick it: a region that lacks the Azure AI Foundry account shows an error below.

basics.name: region
basics.label: Region
basics.toolTip: The Azure region every Findable resource is created in. It is independent of the resource group's region, so a redeploy into an existing group can still pick any region. The checks below and on the next tabs tell you when the region lacks something the install needs.

options.text: [concat('Azure AI Foundry accounts (S0) are not offered in ', basics('region'), '. The deployment would fail: choose a region that offers them.')]

elements.name: sizePreset
elements.label: Size preset
elements.toolTip: Trial runs on a B1 App Service, Basic AI Search and Basic-plan logs: the cheapest set that runs Findable end to end. Production runs on P1v3, Standard search with the semantic ranker and Analytics-plan logs with configurable retention.

allowedValues.label: Trial
allowedValues.description: B1 App Service, Basic AI Search, model capacity 10 (chat) and 50 (embedding), 30-day Basic logs. For a 30-day trial or a small pilot.

allowedValues.label: Production
allowedValues.description: P1v3 App Service, Standard AI Search with the semantic ranker, model capacity 50 and 120, Analytics-plan logs.

options.text: [concat('The ', if(equals(steps('sizing').sizePreset, 'production'), 'P1v3', 'B1'), ' Linux App Service tier is not offered in ', basics('region'), '. The deployment would fail: choose the other preset or another region.')]

elements.name: semanticRanker
elements.label: Semantic ranker on the search service
elements.toolTip: Reranks search results with the semantic ranker (free tier on Trial, standard on Production). Azure offers it in most regions but not all, and there is no way to check before deploying: if the deployment fails creating the search service, switch this off and deploy again.

elements.name: logRetentionDays
elements.label: Log retention (days)
elements.toolTip: How long the Analytics-plan tables keep Findable's logs. Basic-plan tables (Trial) keep 30 days.

options.text: Azure charges for these resources on this subscription, separately from the Findable license. Cosmos DB is serverless and Storage is standard tier in both presets.

The models deploy on an Azure AI Foundry account in the chosen region: the chat model named here and text-embedding-3-small for indexing and retrieval. Availability varies by region: if the chat model is not offered where you deploy, pick another, or switch its deployment off and add a model endpoint afterwards in Admin > Models.

elements.name: deployChatModel
elements.label: Deploy a chat model
elements.toolTip: Off leaves Findable without a chat model until an administrator adds an endpoint in Admin > Models.

elements.name: chatModel
elements.label: Chat model
elements.toolTip: The model name as the Azure AI Foundry catalog lists it. GPT-5.6 is a family: gpt-5.6-terra (balanced, the default), gpt-5.6-sol (strongest reasoning) or gpt-5.6-luna (fastest); GPT-6 is gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna or gpt-6.1-terra. A bare gpt-5.6 is not a catalog name and is refused.

constraints.validationMessage: A model name: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

validations.message: [concat(steps('models').chatModel, ' is not offered as a GlobalStandard deployment in ', basics('region'), '. Pick a model the region offers, another region, or switch the chat deployment off.')]

elements.name: chatQuotaWarning
elements.visible: [and(steps('models').deployChatModel, and(not(empty(steps('models').regionUsagesApi.value)), greater(length(filter(steps('models').regionUsagesApi.value, (u) => and(equals(u.name.value, concat('OpenAI.GlobalStandard.', steps('models').chatModel)), less(sub(u.limit, u.currentValue), if(equals(steps('sizing').sizePreset, 'production'), 50, 10))))), 0)))]

options.text: [concat('This subscription has less than ', if(equals(steps('sizing').sizePreset, 'production'), 50, 10), 'K tokens per minute of GlobalStandard quota left for ', steps('models').chatModel, ' in ', basics('region'), '. The deployment would fail on quota: request more in Azure AI Foundry, pick another model or region, or switch the chat deployment off.')]
[concat('text-embedding-3-small is not offered as a Standard deployment in ', basics('region'), '. Findable needs it for indexing and retrieval: choose another region.')]

[concat('This subscription has less than ', if(equals(steps('sizing').sizePreset, 'production'), 120, 50), 'K tokens per minute of Standard quota left for text-embedding-3-small in ', basics('region'), '. The deployment would fail on quota: request more in Azure AI Foundry or choose another region.')]

elements.name: licenseKey
elements.toolTip: The key from your Findable welcome email (it starts with FNDL1). Leave it empty to enter it on the License page after the first sign-in; the installation does not run until a valid key is entered. Keys and renewals: support@findable.net.

constraints.validationMessage: A Findable license key reads FNDL1.<payload>.<signature>; paste the whole key.

options.text: Every trial is 30 days. The key is verified by the application, never sent to Findable, and can be replaced on the License page at any time.

When the deployment finishes, open the address in the deployment's webAppUrl output followed by /#/start (https://<deployment name>-<7-character suffix>.azurewebsites.net/#/start; the nextStep output carries the full link). The first-run page connects Findable to your Microsoft Entra tenant (two app registrations and the administrators group) and finishes the setup. Role assignments can take up to ten minutes to apply after the deployment reports success. Support: support@findable.net.
